author: ToHubLab
name: Sticky
short: Keep a message at the bottom of a channel.
description: Automatically reposts a sticky message at the bottom of a channel. Includes an interactive menu, per-channel debounce delays to prevent spam, and a full overview of all active stickies.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores channel IDs, sticky message content, and per-channel delay settings.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Sticky v2! 🐙

New in this version:
• Interactive menu with `.sticky menu`
• Per-channel debounce delays
• Cleaner overview of all stickies
